policy.initial_observations: 3 mode-one training plus2 mode-one development, all5 charged
policy.learner_seed: 958000+spec_index, identical for paired policies and noise conditions
policy.global_freeze: all 216 policy episodes and 1080 declared budget slots frozen before generating 54 clean final references; unavailable checkpoints remain failed slots
policy.final_release_tracking: data/final_release.json created exclusively before first final generation; scientific-source and deterministic-task identity survive new preparation timestamps; later outputs are reproductions
policy.primary_metrics: budget9 noise1 mean across18 parameter tasks of the maximum true-term relative coefficient error; structure and forecast guardrails retained
policy.predeclared_promotion: primary mean at least10% lower than fixed_rich and rich_then_variance, no worse than other retained controls, with predeclared structure and forecast guardrails; offline reporting only
policy.offline_success: exact support AND worst true coefficient error<=10% AND three-trajectory mean forecast relativeL2<=5%
policy.cost_savings: only at same predeclared80% offline-success target; unavailable if either policy never reaches it
policy.uncertainty_metrics: support-set coverage and size, singleton-wrong diagnostic, positive/negative term Brier separately; frequencies are not calibrated probabilities
policy.scope: fresh controlled synthetic coefficient-information study; old active results and KS5.4104% result unchanged
